2609.03667.title: Out-of-Distribution Generalisation with Sequence Models in Offline Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
2609.03667.paper_summary: Generalising to unseen tasks remains a fundamental challenge in offline multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL). In this work, we present a principled analysis of zero-shot task generalisation in the offline setting and conduct an extensive empirical investigation into the scaling behaviour governing task diversity, dataset size, and network capacity. To facilitate this study, we extend offline sequence modelling architectures to handle multi-task observation and action spaces alongside variable agent counts across tasks. Our primary finding is that scaling task diversity---rather than sheer dataset size is the dominant factor in achieving robust zero-shot transfer. Through large-scale experiments across four challenging environments (Connector, RWARE, SMAX, and LBF), we demonstrate that our multi-task approach achieves a mean improvement of 3.2x on held-out test tasks compared to single-task models and consistently outperforms strong behaviour cloning baselines. These results suggest that the development of generalisable MARL agents should prioritise the diversity of the training distribution with varying numbers of agents, providing a roadmap for scaling offline MARL effectively.
2609.03667.paper_summary_zh: 一般化到未見任務仍然是離線多智能體強化學習（MARL）中的一個基本挑戰。在這項工作中，我們對離線環境中的零樣本任務一般化進行了原則性的分析，並對影響任務多樣性、數據集大小和網絡容量的縮放行為進行了廣泛的實證研究。為了促進這項研究，我們擴展了離線序列建模架構，以處理多任務觀察和行動空間，以及跨任務的可變智能體數量。我們的主要發現是，任務多樣性的縮放——而不是單純的數據集大小，是實現穩健零樣本轉移的主導因素。通過在四個具有挑戰性的環境（Connector、RWARE、SMAX 和 LBF）中進行大規模實驗，我們證明我們的多任務方法在保留的測試任務上相比於單任務模型實現了平均 3.2 倍的改善，並且始終優於強大的行為克隆基準。這些結果表明，開發可一般化的 MARL 智能體應優先考慮訓練分佈的多樣性，並且智能體數量不同，為有效擴展離線 MARL 提供了一個路線圖。
